narrative.overview: The examples use a dark workspace, a paper interface study, and coral controls. The existing repository banner supplies the visual context. This record describes the example app and does not replace the repository's identity.
dos: Do preserve readable content before motion begins.
Do keep source links beside each example.
Do preserve focus, touch, interruption, and reduced-motion behavior when editing.
donts: Don't treat a screenshot or a source scan as an independent release approval.
Don't extend the video font exception into the app's visual identity.
